facts.fact: Equinix's Johannesburg 1 (JN1) data centre in Germiston has completed its first phase of 4MW and has customers using it as a colocation and interconnection site; Equinix entered South Africa in 2024, and the document gives no opening date, so as_of is its publication date.

note: Two further 10MW phases and Johannesburg and Cape Town land parcels are planned, not facts.
